class-value-concept.title: Associate cached data with classes using ClassValue
class-value-concept.short: Store lazily computed values per Class without managing a global class-keyed map
class-value-concept.summary: ClassValue provides a way to compute and associate a value with each Class object while allowing class unloading to be handled correctly.
class-value-concept.why: Frameworks often need per-class metadata, and ClassValue avoids common lifetime problems of manually maintained global maps keyed by Class.
class-value-concept.tips: Keep computeValue deterministic enough to tolerate recomputation and use remove when an associated value must be invalidated.

cleaner-concept.title: Use Cleaner only as a cleanup safety net
cleaner-concept.short: Register fallback cleanup without relying on finalization
cleaner-concept.summary: Cleaner associates cleanup actions with objects so resources can be reclaimed after an object becomes phantom reachable.
cleaner-concept.why: It can provide a fallback for resources whose owners were not explicitly closed, but cleanup timing is not deterministic.
cleaner-concept.tips: Use AutoCloseable and try-with-resources for primary resource management; keep Cleaner actions independent of the cleaned object.

collections-rotate.title: Rotate list elements with Collections.rotate
collections-rotate.short: Shift every element cyclically by a distance
collections-rotate.summary: Collections.rotate moves list elements cyclically, wrapping elements that pass an end back to the other side.
collections-rotate.why: It expresses cyclic rearrangement directly without manually slicing and rebuilding a list.
collections-rotate.tips: Positive distances rotate toward higher indexes; negative distances rotate toward lower indexes.

arrays-compare.title: Compare arrays lexicographically with Arrays.compare
arrays-compare.short: Order arrays by their first differing elements
arrays-compare.summary: Arrays.compare compares two arrays lexicographically and returns a negative, zero, or positive result.
arrays-compare.why: It avoids hand-written loops for common array ordering logic.
arrays-compare.tips: Choose the overload matching the element type and do not confuse lexicographic comparison with equality.

illformed-locale-exception.title: IllformedLocaleException
illformed-locale-exception.short: Use well-formed BCP 47 components when building a Locale
illformed-locale-exception.summary: IllformedLocaleException is thrown by Locale.Builder when a language tag or locale component is syntactically ill-formed.
illformed-locale-exception.why: The builder performs stricter validation than some older Locale construction paths and rejects malformed language-tag syntax.
illformed-locale-exception.tips: Use hyphen-separated BCP 47 language tags such as en-US and validate externally supplied locale identifiers before building them.

missing-resource-exception.title: MissingResourceException
missing-resource-exception.short: Check resource bundle names and packaged locale data
missing-resource-exception.summary: MissingResourceException indicates that a requested resource bundle or resource key could not be found.
missing-resource-exception.why: Localization lookup depends on correct base names, available bundles, locale fallback, and matching keys.
missing-resource-exception.tips: Verify that resource files are packaged and that base names and keys exactly match the lookup code.

multi-catch-related-types-error.title: Multi-catch alternatives cannot be related by subclassing
multi-catch-related-types-error.short: Do not list both a superclass and its subclass in one multi-catch
multi-catch-related-types-error.summary: A multi-catch declaration is invalid when one alternative exception type is a subclass of another alternative.
multi-catch-related-types-error.why: The broader alternative already catches instances of the narrower type, making the narrower alternative redundant.
multi-catch-related-types-error.tips: Keep only the broader type or use separate catch blocks when the exceptions require different handling.

sealed-permits-non-direct-subclass-error.title: permits must name direct subclasses
sealed-permits-non-direct-subclass-error.short: List only classes that directly extend a sealed class
sealed-permits-non-direct-subclass-error.summary: A sealed class permits clause may name only its direct subclasses or direct implementors.
sealed-permits-non-direct-subclass-error.why: Sealing controls the immediate inheritance boundary; descendants are governed through those permitted direct subtypes.
sealed-permits-non-direct-subclass-error.tips: Permit the direct subtype, then mark that subtype final, sealed, or non-sealed as appropriate.

removal-deprecation-warning.title: Removal deprecation warning
removal-deprecation-warning.short: Migrate away from APIs deprecated for removal
removal-deprecation-warning.summary: javac can warn when code uses an API whose deprecation metadata indicates that it is intended to be removed.
removal-deprecation-warning.why: Such APIs carry a stronger compatibility risk than ordinary deprecated APIs because a future Java release may delete them.
removal-deprecation-warning.tips: Check the API documentation for its replacement and migrate before upgrading to a release that removes it.

bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.title: BigDecimal.equals also compares scale
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.short: Use compareTo when only numerical value should matter
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.summary: BigDecimal.equals considers both numerical value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal by equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.why: Code that expects mathematical equality can behave unexpectedly in comparisons and collections keyed by BigDecimal.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.tips: Use compareTo for value-only ordering or equality checks, and define a consistent scale policy when using BigDecimal as a key.
